title.en: An Act Repealing Republic Acts Numbered Sixty-one Hundred Forty-five and Fifty-four Hundred Seventy-four (Re: Prohibition to Catch Fish Called "Ipon" During Certain Months of the Year, Etc.)

text.en: Republic Acts Numbered Sixty-one hundred forty-five and Fifty-four hundred seventy-four are hereby repealed by this Act.
All provisions of existing laws, orders, decrees, rules and regulations inconsistent herewith are likewise repealed.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
